## What changed and why

Describe the small, coherent change and its purpose.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Note anything unverified or incomplete.

## Documentation and handoff

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` records this change with its actual timestamp and validation.
- [ ] `README.md` reflects any setup or behavior changes, if applicable.
- [ ] `AI_USAGE.md` reflects any meaningful Codex contribution, if applicable.
- [ ] The code uses simple patterns and includes no credentials or private data.

## Related work

Task ID and related issue (if one exists):

## Screenshots or recording

For visual changes, include desktop/mobile and relevant error states. Omit private information.

## GhostRoute review checklist

- [ ] Relevant PRD/architecture/ADR and task acceptance criteria are satisfied.
- [ ] Organizer requirements and workflows are preserved.
- [ ] New nontrivial logic has a meaningful test; blocked-route behavior is tested if affected.
- [ ] Keyboard/mobile behavior and failure states were checked where relevant.
- [ ] Simulated data is labeled and source attribution is preserved.
- [ ] No safety, shelter availability, CI or deployment claim exceeds the evidence.

## Known risks or follow-up work

State limitations, unresolved decisions and checks not run.
